name: Fluminense Portuguese
notes: Fluminense: Rio de Janeiro state outside the capital. Coda /S/ stays alveolar [s z]: in the North-Northwest of the state 'há predomínio das realizações alveolares, ao contrário do que acontece na capital do Estado' (Hora 1999: 34-35, reporting Brandão). Coda /R/ is glottal [h], 80 % of state tokens in ALiB (Silva 2023: 68). These two features separate it from the Carioca of the capital (pt-BR-x-rj), whose coda /S/ is palatal.

sources.notes: NURC cultured-speech corpus (5 capitals). p.135, Tabela 1: coda /S/ palatalisation ('chiado carioca') in Rio reaches 91% word-internally and 76% word-finally (1990s real-time data), vs alveolar 4%/19% - the defining Carioca feature, highest among the major capitals. p.137-138: coda /R/ posteriorised; Callou (1987) - the predominant cultured-Carioca coda /R/ is the velar fricative [x], except word-finally where deletion or aspiration [h] prevail. Analyses co-authored with Leite & Moraes (1996, 2002, 2003).

allophone_rules.notes: Word-final coda /R/ is the glottal fricative, as in FLU_CODA_R_GLOTTAL (Silva 2023: 68).
Coda /R/ is the glottal fricative. Silva (2023: 68, ALiB): 'no Rio de Janeiro, registramos 793 róticos, sendo 80% de glotal'.

A coda /S/ takes the voicing of a following voiced consonant: mesmo [ˈmezmu], desde [ˈdezd͡ʒi]. Barbosa & Albano (2004: 229): 'it tends to assimilate the voicing of the following sound'. The list leaves out the tap and reads the next slot on the second pass, after BR_STRONG_R_AFTER_CODA has written ⟨r⟩ as the voiceless strong rhotic [x], so a coda sibilant before it stays voiceless: desrespeito [desxesˈpejtu].

An ⟨r⟩ after a coda consonant is the strong rhotic of rio [ˈxiu]: honra [ˈõxɐ], genro [ˈʒẽxu]. Cristófaro Silva (2025: 240) puts the R-forte in one class across three contexts: 'início de sílaba que coincide com início de palavra (rapaz, rio, rosa etc.); início de sílaba em meio de palavra (carro, terra) ou início de sílaba após consoante (Israel, desrespeito etc.)'.

location.notes: the state of Rio de Janeiro — this spec is the state BEYOND the capital, so the point is the state's centroid, not the city's. [Wikidata Q41428 P625]
